# Controlled AI Workflow Agent

Build an assistant that completes a narrow, bounded multistep task using approved tools.

## Required behavior
- [ ] Task decomposition and typed inputs
- [ ] Restricted tool permissions and confirmations
- [ ] Retries, audit logs, and human approval for consequential actions

Use synthetic or properly licensed data. Do not commit credentials or personal data. Document setup, evaluation, limitations, and reset instructions.

"""Starter scaffold for Controlled AI Workflow Agent.

Implement one milestone at a time and keep evaluation separate from development.
"""

def main():
    print("Project: Controlled AI Workflow Agent")
    print("Next step: define inputs, outputs, baseline, and evaluation criteria.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
